analysis_set: REPLACE-BG independent pairs (reference not used for calibration), meter rows only, all participants, in-window days
comparison_set_B: same but all reference sources (meter rows + pump BG rows)
ci: 95 % percentile CI from a bootstrap that resamples participants

reference_quality.why: a fingerstick and a CGM reading agree exactly by chance in about 2 % of pairs; pump BG rows typed by the patient agree far more often in the CGM-only arm after randomisation, so they are mostly CGM values typed into the pump, not fingersticks
reference_quality.rule_used: the analysis set keeps meter rows only (source = meter); pump rows are dropped

coarse.method: nearest real CGM reading within 5 min of (fingerstick time + T); pairs with a reading at every T

fine.method: straight-line interpolation between the readings before and after (fingerstick time + T), both within 7.5 min

lag_correction.method: same pairs; CGM reading nearest to fingerstick time + 5 min (within 5 min); ranges re-binned by the new average

lag_check_cgm_bgm_randomised.set: CGM+BGM arm, meter rows, pairs on or after the randomisation day

roc.roc_source: central difference of the paired CGM reading's neighbours (cache); the bin is the trend at the fingerstick time

wear_day.why_confirmed_only: a session is confirmed when a calibration was entered in the 30 min before its first reading; unconfirmed sessions are mostly signal-loss fragments, where wear_day restarts at 1 by mistake

confound_check.subset: pairs with average 70-180 mg/dL and stable rate of change (-1 to 1 mg/dL per min)

mixed_model.outcome: absolute relative difference (ARD, %) of each pair, as paired (no lag correction)
mixed_model.fixed_effects: range (by average) + rate-of-change bin + wear day (1, 2-6, 7) + night + study arm

terms.term: baseline: 70-180 mg/dL, stable, wear day 2-6, daytime, CGM-only arm
falling (-2 to -1 mg/dL per min) vs stable
falling fast (< -2 mg/dL per min) vs stable
rising (1 to 2 mg/dL per min) vs stable
rising fast (> 2 mg/dL per min) vs stable

shanghai.set: Shanghai T1DM + T2DM fingerstick pairs; the fingerstick sits on the nearest 15-min CGM row (up to 7.5 min slack)

timing_slack.what: calibration entry time (receiver clock) minus the matching meter reading time (meter clock), same value, within 15 min; includes the delay between the fingerstick and typing it in
